title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the McLaren F1
description:
The McLaren F one was built with a small amount of real gold inside its engine bay. Not as decoration. As a heat shield. And the same car, a road car with a luggage set and air conditioning, went on to win the twenty-four hours of Le Mans at its very first attempt, even though its creator never wanted it to race. Those are the two things you probably did not know about the McLaren F one. Here is the twist. The first fact explains why the second one was possible. Because the same obsession that led to gold foil, an obsession with weight and heat, is what made a road car light enough and reliable enough to beat purpose-built prototypes in the rain.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
